measurement_boundary: TCP-stream bytes including TLS records and HTTP/1.1 framing; frontend plus gateway egress; excludes TCP/IP packets; setup/cleanup separate
memory_attribution: co-host whole-process observation/budget only; not per-protocol memory savings
cpu_attribution: co-host process CPU delta brackets workflow including cold frontend shutdown and counter-read overhead; no protocol attribution
scope: post-transition immutable HTTP workflows; transition/probe/setup/cleanup excluded; no delta/stream/native NCP/provider claim
